_doc: Channel release-schedule state machine. Read by the daily-shorts-pipeline routine at fire-time to decide which verticals + formats to produce. Updated manually (or by phase_N_report.md output) at phase transitions.
_kept_verticals_note: Phase 1 rotation pool. Cases excluded to conserve EL budget (already have 6 live in old format). Phase 2 narrows to top 2-3 by median avg view %.
_videos_per_fire_note: Cap is 2. Phase 1+2 produce 2 different verticals per fire. Phase 3 may produce 2 of same vertical with different hook formulas.
_el_budget_note: Soft cap at 90k chars/mo (10k headroom under Creator's 100k). Upgraded from Starter (25k cap) on 2026-05-18 after user moved to Creator tier. Hard refuse at 90k unless --over-budget flag passed.
_auto_advance_note: Always false. Human approves each phase transition after reviewing phase_N_report.md.
